decisions.reason: Reliability postmortem on a Microsoft 365 outage caused by a latent Windows defect, not a security event or advisory.
Reddit post promoting a post-quantum trust project with no security incident, advisory, or research finding.
FBI FLASH warning on criminal ARTEX abuse, same advisory covered by existing ARTEX stories; attach to the canonical story rather than mint a duplicate.

decisions.story_title: Fake Prime Gaming x FC 27 reward site harvests EA passwords and 2FA codes
decisions.reason: Concrete phishing campaign with a cloned EA sign-in form stealing credentials and 2FA codes after the FC 27 launch.
Tenable product availability announcement and vendor marketing for Adversary View.
Generic consumer advice on preparing accounts after death, not a security event.
Honeypot scans for the LiteLLM/Starlette chain that includes CVE-2026-48710, the subject of this existing story; the Cisco cluster had swept it in only through shared CVE tags.

CVE-2026-42271.evidence: Honeypots saw requests for /mcp-rest/test/tools/list that appear to attempt exploitation of the LiteLLM/Starlette chain; no successful compromise is reported.

CVE-2026-48710.evidence: Same honeypot requests target the chain described in Horizon3's write-up, but the event reports scan attempts rather than confirmed exploitation.
